name: REVO Insurance S.p.A.
summary: REVO Insurance S.p.A. operates as an insurance company in Italy. The company offers non-life insurance with a focus on specialty lines and parametric risks business. It also provides insurance against parametric, deposits, financial lines, various risks cars, property and engineering, casualty, agriculture, surety, aviation, private credit, fine art, marine, and legal protection, as well as REVO for microenterprise. In addition, the company offers insurance brokerage services. The company is headquartered in Milan, Italy.
